(* substantial presence test: 31-day floor plus weighted 3-year day count must reach 183 *)
let meets_substantial_presence_test (days_current_year : int) (days_1st_preceding_year : int) (days_2nd_preceding_year : int) : bool =
  let present_31_days = days_current_year >= 31 in
  let weighted_day_count =
    float_of_int days_current_year *. 1.0 +.
    float_of_int days_1st_preceding_year *. (1.0 /. 3.0) +.
    float_of_int days_2nd_preceding_year *. (1.0 /. 6.0)
  in
  present_31_days && weighted_day_count >= 183.0

(* 7701(b)(3) -- Substantial presence test: wraps base test (A) with its exceptions (B), (C), and (D); exception priority resolved externally by DAG, not here *)
module Substantial_presence_test = struct
  (* (A) base test defined separately as meets_substantial_presence_test *)

  (* (B) exception: present fewer than 183 days in current year and has closer connection to a foreign country than to the United States *)
  let closer_connection_exception (days_current_year : int) (sec_911_d_3 : bool) (* cross-ref: §911(d)(3) -- tax home in a foreign country, without regard to the second sentence thereof *) (has_closer_connection_to_foreign_country : bool) : bool =
    days_current_year < 183 &&
    sec_911_d_3 &&
    has_closer_connection_to_foreign_country

  (* (C) exception to (B): bars the closer connection exception if individual sought adjustment of status or lawful permanent resident status during the year *)
  let adjustment_of_status_bar (has_pending_adjustment_of_status_application : bool) (took_steps_toward_lawful_permanent_resident_status : bool) : bool =
    has_pending_adjustment_of_status_application ||
    took_steps_toward_lawful_permanent_resident_status

  (* (D) exception: a day is not counted as a day of presence if individual is an exempt individual or medically unable to leave *)
  let excluded_presence_day (is_exempt_individual : bool) (unable_to_leave_due_to_medical_condition_arising_during_presence : bool) : bool =
    is_exempt_individual ||
    unable_to_leave_due_to_medical_condition_arising_during_presence
end
